A discoverable contract for application authorisation

The metadata view turns the App Security domain into an explorable integration surface. Consumers can see the entities and endpoints behind apps, users, roles and privileges before writing a client, reducing guesswork and accidental coupling to internal implementation.

Use this reference when building administration tools, integrations or diagnostics that must understand app-local access without crossing into the SSO account boundary.
